findings.title: setUTCMonth overflows on month-end anchors, removing the day clamp
findings.explanation: The PR description claims setUTCMonth handles rollover, but it does not clamp the day of month. For Jan 31, setUTCMonth(1) gives Feb 31, which rolls over to Mar 3 (or Mar 2 in a leap year). The removed code deliberately clamped to the last day of the next month, so Jan 31 renewed on Feb 28/29. The same bug affects Mar 31 -> May 1, May 31 -> Jul 1, Aug 31 -> Oct 1, and Oct 31 -> Dec 1. In a billing service this means customers are charged on the wrong date and periods can be skewed or overlap. Restore the clamping. For example, compute the last day of the target month with Date.UTC(y, m + 2, 0) and use Math.min(anchorDay, lastDay). Alternatively, set the date to 1 first, then set the month, then set the day to the clamped value.

findings.title: No regression tests for month-end behavior
findings.explanation: The removed comment documented an important edge case, and this change silently breaks it. Add tests for Jan 31 (non-leap and leap years), Mar 31, Dec 31 (year rollover), and a normal mid-month date. These tests would have caught the regression.

findings.title: Removed explanatory comment about clamping
findings.explanation: The business rule that a period starting on Jan 31 renews on Feb 28/29 is no longer documented anywhere. Keep that comment, or add one, next to whichever implementation is used, so the intent is not lost again.

findings.title: Anchor-day drift in chained periods
findings.explanation: Even with the clamp restored, chaining nextPeriod(end) drifts the anchor (Jan 31 -> Feb 28 -> Mar 28). If the original anchor day matters, consider passing the anchor day explicitly. This behavior is the same as before, so it is not a regression.

prompt:
Review this pull request.

## Simplify next billing period calculation

Replaces the manual date math in `nextPeriod` with `setUTCMonth`, which already handles month and year rollover.

## Diff

```diff
diff --git a/src/services/billing.ts b/src/services/billing.ts
index 81ad02d..eb1824d 100644
--- a/src/services/billing.ts
+++ b/src/services/billing.ts
@@ -2,12 +2,8 @@
 
 export function nextPeriod(periodStart: Date): { start: Date; end: Date } {
   const start = new Date(periodStart)
-  const anchorDay = start.getUTCDate()
-  const year = start.getUTCFullYear()
-  const month = start.getUTCMonth() + 1
-  // Clamp to the last day of the next month, so a period starting on Jan 31 renews on Feb 28/29.
-  const lastDayOfNextMonth = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month + 1, 0)).getUTCDate()
-  const end = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, Math.min(anchorDay, lastDayOfNextMonth)))
+  const end = new Date(periodStart)
+  end.setUTCMonth(end.getUTCMonth() + 1)
   return { start, end }
 }
```
